items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: And a young Christian McBride was there.

ctx.x: Yeah, that’s a good question. I think what makes a good song for me is number one can somebody relate to it. It doesn’t have to have lyrics, but if you’re talking an instrumental, something that has a good pocket and a good groove, whether it’s pop or jazz, and a melody that someone can walk away, you know like an earworm where they hear that melody and they can’t get it out of their head. I think that’s what makes a good song.
You gave me a memory of — we used to go to the jazz parties to gather interviews and we went to one in Sarasota. This was probably in 1996. And a young Christian McBride was there.
